idk yet | Snapshot. | Wraith comps are generally auto-friendly that can have optimizations to squeeze more damage.

General Rotation
1.  Use both Support Skills
2.  Use Wraith skills while weaving a few auto attacks between each skill activation to proc her tornadoes

When to use Ultimate?
• Wraith: Whenever there's a need to dodge big attacks from enemies (preferably also while waiting for her supports' skills cooldown to come back up).
• Nazuka: Preferably when there's a break window and also when her Support Skill CD is around 7s+ to not delay its cast.
• Ann: To block target attacks or disrupt disruptable enemies.

Tips
• Wraith: Use her Main Skill sparingly (keeping it at 2 stacks always) while waiting for Ann's Support Skill to snapshot her tornadoes with all of Ann's buffs.
The goal of this team is to set up Nazuna and S. Coronis’ skills before deploying Gerie to maximize her damage. It is important for Gerie's attacks to hit as not doing so results in an irrecoverable damage loss, to the point of warranting a full restart.

General Rotation
1. Nazuna Main Skill
2. S. Coronis Supp. Skill
3. Wait 1s then use Gerie Supp. Skill

When to use Ultimate?
• Nazuna: Whenever available as long as her skill is not cancelled.
• Gerie: Never because apparently, the effects of Samsara's Judgment doesn't affect Mark DMG.
• S. Coronis (w/ Talent 3): Whenever available as long as her skill is not cancelled.

Tips
• While S. Coronis' Supp. Skill covers a large area, be careful of its usage against enemies that have high mobility as you will lose out on the buffs that it can provide. | This team generally relies on Minova and Tilia to support Firefly to do as much damage as possible with their potentials.

General Rotation
1. Firefly Supp. Skill
2. Tilia Supp. Skill
3. Minova full Auto Attack chain (she has 5 AA hits)
4. Minova Main Skill

When to use Ultimate?
• Minova: idk yet
• Firefly: When there is around 5s left in her Support Skill's cooldown.
• Tilia: Whenever available as long as her skill is not cancelled and Firefly is in the battlefield.

Tips and Other Information
• Firefly takes a while to start attacking (2.4s according to ruyu) so it is fine to deploy her early on.
• Using Minova's skill after every 5th AA hit allows for More Than Just Pretty to have constant uptime.
• Her 5th AA hit has a unique *ding* sound cue to aid you on when to use her Main Skill again. | This team is pretty straightforward and even auto friendly as there is no need for manual skill usage input.

General Rotation
1. Mistique or Coronis Supp. Skill
2. Otoha Supp. Skill + Cosette Main Skill

When to use Ultimate?
• Cosette (w/ Nether Blaze): Before using her skill.
• Otoha: Only when her skill is in cooldown.
• Mistique: Whenever available as long as her skill is not cancelled.
• Coronis: Preferably when the enemy has resilience bar active.

4. Wait 2s then use Fuyuka's Ultimate | *Credits to Soh for the detailed rotation

General Rotation
1. Nazuna Main Skill
2. Wait 2s then use Nazuka Supp. Skill + Ann Supp. Skill
3. Ensure that both Ann and Nazuka's Supp. Skills line up by using Ann’s skill only when Nazuka’s skill CD hits 4s.

When to use Ultimate?
• Nazuna: After using her skill and ensure that it is timed 2s before using Nazuka's skill.
• Nazuka: When skill cooldown hits 10s.
• Ann: 1s before Nazuka's skill (but not at the same time as Nazuna's Ultimate)

Tips and Additional Information
• Nazuna reloads faster if she is constantly moving.
• Nazuna restores energy faster if you cancel her reload animation by dashing.

Additional Timings During Nazuka's Ultimate
• Use Ann's skill when Nazuka's ultimate is at 24s CD (Nazuka skill: 4s CD)
• Use Nazuna's skill and ultimate when Nazuka's ultimate is at 22s CD (Nazuka skill: 2s CD)

One, Two, Three Jump! Disc Effect Snapshot
• This assumes that you have One, Two, Three, Jump! disc on Main slot.
• Nazuka’s Ultimate allows her next skill usage to carry over the disc’s snapshot benefits.
• Only use Nazuka's Ultimate just before her skill hits to snapshot the disc’s buff for maximum damage. | idk yet | idk yet | General Rotation

idk yet | idk yet | idk yet | idk yet | The goal of this team is to allow Firenze's Nimble Step potential to have permanent uptime as it allows High Risk to be proc'd consistently.

General Rotation
Firenze/Cosette/Otoha or Coronis
1. Cosette Supp. Skill + Otoha/Coronis Supp. Skill
2. 1st Firenze Main Skill when Cosette skill hits 11s CD
3. 2nd Firenze Main Skill when Cosette skill hits 5s CD
*Note: This can be auto friendly if Firenze does not get staggered or miss any skill hits.

w/o Mistique pre-casting
1. Mistique Supp. Skill + Cosette Supp. Skill
2. 1st Firenze Main Skill when Cosette skill hits 11s CD
3. 2nd Firenze Main Skill when Cosette skill hits 5s CD

w/ Mistique pre-casting
1. Mistique Supp. Skill
2. Wait until Mistique's Supp. Skill CD reaches 2s
3. Cosette Supp. Skill
4. 1st Firenze Main Skill when Cosette skill hits 11s CD
5. Mistique Supp. Skill
6. 2nd Firenze Main Skill when Cosette skill hits 5s CD

When to use Ultimate?
• Firenze: Ensure that Nimble Step is still active with around 3+ seconds left and Cosette is still on the field.
• Cosette (w/ Nether Blaze): Before using her skill.
• Otoha: When her skill CD is at 5-11s.
• Mistique: Whenever available as long as her skill is not cancelled.
• Coronis: Preferably when the enemy has resilience bar active.

Tips
• If you have Wisteria Dream as Main Disc, use Firenze's skill (or any Umbra unit that spawns a minion like Mistique) until she has 3 stacks of Reverence if the Boss Blitz stage allows it. The Evernight Emberflies stage is a perfect example for this as it is not an instant battle against the boss.
